title: Glandular trichome development, morphology, and maturation are influenced by plant age and genotype in high THC-containing cannabis (Cannabis sativa L.) inflorescences
notes: Cannabis-specific study showing plant-age/genotype effects, asynchronous trichome development, senescence/dehiscence, and drying effects on trichome morphology. Visual trichome maturity should therefore be interpreted as one evidence stream, not an exact universal harvest clock.
